definitions.explanation: The highest point of a road crossing mountains.
The most critical or intense point of something.

examples.japanese: {峠|とうげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧。

examples.english: The mountain pass road was steep.

examples.japanese: {峠|とうげ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{茶屋|ちゃや}→茶屋：14020_chaya⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あった→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There was a teahouse at the mountain pass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}えた→越える：02099_koeru⟧。
examples.english: The illness passed its crisis point.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{過|す}ぎた→過ぎる：01219_sugiru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧⟦{少|すこ}し→少し：00596_sukoshi⟧⟦{楽|らく}→楽：02169_raku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: The busiest period at work has passed, so things have gotten a bit easier.

examples.japanese: ⟦{台風|たいふう}→台風：01455_taifuu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{越|こ}えた→越える：02099_koeru⟧⟦ようだ→ようだ：26593_youda⟧。
examples.english: It seems the worst of the typhoon has passed.

notes:
ETYMOLOGY:
- The highest point when crossing a mountain
- ⟦{山道|やまみち}→山道：12406_yamamichi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ} (mountain pass)

FIGURATIVE MEANING:
- The most critical or turning point
- ⟦{病気|びょうき}→病気：00771_byouki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ} (crisis point of illness)
- ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{峠|とうげ} (peak of work)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {峠|とうげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}える→越える：02099_koeru⟧: to pass the peak/get over the worst
- {峠|とうげ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{越|こ}す→越す：02282_kosu⟧: same meaning, variant form
- ⟦{峠|とうげ}{道|みち}→峠道：23600_tougemichi⟧: mountain pass road

WRITING:
{峠|とうげ} is a Japanese-made kanji (⟦{国字|こくじ}→国字：28106_kokuji⟧): ⟦{山|やま}→山：02168_yama⟧ + ⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧ + ⟦{下|した}→下：00670_shita⟧.
